The SPEC asked for a "CC-licensed low-poly bunny". The well-known Stanford Bunny is not
under a Creative Commons licence, so the project generates its own bunny and dedicates
it to the public domain. Regenerate all meshes with `uv run python scripts/make_fixtures.py`.

3MF test archives (units, production extension, nested components, materials, Bambu and
Prusa slicer projects, error cases) are built on the fly in `tests/test_threemf.py`.
